controllingFact: The logical operation committed on attempt one even though its response was lost; the retry was a duplicate-denied attempt. Operation outcome and attempt outcome must be represented separately, and the original committed result must remain discoverable.

nearestCredibleCompetitor.whyItFails: It lets the last observed retry denial overwrite durable evidence that the same logical operation already committed, then invites a new operation ID that can duplicate the side effect.

nearestCredibleCompetitor.whyItFails: Model version and provider request ID identify other dimensions; rolling both changed components back together still cannot attribute which component caused the drop.
